confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Kuala Lumpur price levels, not checked against live listings or current menus. Restaurant anchors (meals, coffee, beer) are more reliable than accommodation and bar anchors, which vary more by district and season. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer and bar price relationship, with weak direct knowledge. FX as_of_date 2026-10-16 and rate 0.6947 come from search-result summaries of the RBA daily table; the RBA overview page in the same results still showed 15 October, so the 16 October figure was not independently confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Southeast Asian capitals with comparable restaurant and hotel price levels (for example Bangkok and Penang), adjusted for Kuala Lumpur's local food-court and kopitiam pricing and its hotel market.
